shouldFix.title: The extraction's entire warrant is the phrase 'the independently reviewed parent' and it pins no review, while the parent's own bytes say the review is still awaited
shouldFix.location: authorityClaim, and the absence of a parentReview entry
shouldFix.finding: A thin extraction has no independent authority of its own. This one says so plainly — 'Thin extraction of one harness from the independently reviewed parent. The parent is the review subject.' — so the adjective 'independently reviewed' is doing all the work. It is not pinned. The artifact cites exactly one digest, the parent's 175723e3, and nothing else: no verdict path, no verdict digest, no verdict standing. Now follow the only route a reader has from this file. Open the parent at 175723e3 and its reviewStatus reads AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW. So the single check available from this artifact returns a direct contradiction of the artifact's warrant, with no pointer to the thing that would resolve it. The claim is in fact true — I resolved it, and the parent's independent verdict exists at core-gate-harness-specifications.v3.review-independent.claude2.json, digest 3f2146ec, recording ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. But I had that digest only because I reviewed two sibling extractions from this parent earlier today, which is not a route the corpus can rely on. The timing removes the obvious excuse: the parent verdict was written at 03:11 and this file at 03:13, so the pin was available two minutes before it was needed, and the v3 extraction from the same parent does carry it, in a parentReview object with path, digest and verdict.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: It matters more here than at any sibling because of what this file is. The dispatch calls it the D-086 artifactPathWhenAuthored occupancy file, and I confirmed it is: the harness object names this exact path. So D-086's promise routes a reader to this file — and this is the one file in the lineage that does not carry the pointer to the review its own authority depends on. The better-provenanced v3 extraction, which does carry parentReview, sits at a path nobody is promised.
shouldFix.whatWouldRepairIt: Add the parentReview object the v3 extraction already contains — path, sha256 3f2146ec, and the ACCEPT 0/0 standing. One object, already written elsewhere in this lineage.

advisories.title: authorityClaim omits the express refusals the v3 sibling carries
advisories.detail: This authorityClaim is four sentences and refuses only by 'It binds NOTHING'. The v3 extraction of the same harness adds four express refusals this one lacks: it does not SATISFY DR-101, it does not close OBL-2, it does not invent a D-006 unit, and it does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. I checked and none of those things is done here — OBL-2, SATISFY, SATISFIED and 'implementation/' do not occur in the artifact at all, and status CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED plus binds NOTHING carry the standing — so silence is not a claim and this stays advisory rather than joining the finding. But two of the dispatch's attack items are refuted here only by absence, where the sibling refutes them by statement, and express refusals are what let a later reader confirm a thing was considered rather than overlooked.

coordinatorSummary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX. Fourteen attacks run, one landed. Custody holds: subject d2d0727b at 0444, 5101 bytes, unmoved and unedited; HEAD never left 5d5d778; required-now 26 of 26. Both cited digests reproduce — the subject cites only one, the parent at 175723e3, plus itself. The extraction is faultless. Its harness object is deep-equal to the parent's single DR-G03 entry by full recursive comparison, and the test this dispatch adds passes: the harness names harness.DR-G03.core-startup.v1.json as the D-086 promised path, and this subject is that file, unlike its v2 and v3 siblings which sit elsewhere. I also checked whether the low version number means stale content and it does not — this file's harness is byte-identical to the 07:39 v3 extraction's and unequal to v2's, and the mtimes bear it out: v2 at 03:02 pinning an earlier parent, parent v3 at 03:08, this file at 03:13. Every prohibition is refuted by measurement rather than by reading disclaimers. The no-load observation is separated from the timing samples in three places and the timed child's ptrace prohibition appears in three. The D-006 unit attack is refuted by enumerating every bare integer in the artifact — fifteen of them, each accounted for as a version, a D-102 machine label, a clause number, a nearest-rank position, N=21, or a D-006 millisecond bound — so no unaccounted number exists for a derived unit to hide in. OBL-2, SATISFY and SATISFIED do not occur at all. Beyond the dispatch, the vacuous-pass route is closed: missing observation is a fail, not a pass. The finding is the file's own load-bearing sentence. A thin extraction has no authority of its own and this one says so — 'Thin extraction of one harness from the independently reviewed parent' — but it pins no review. It cites one digest, the parent's, and no verdict path, digest or standing. Follow the only route it offers and the parent's own bytes read AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW, so the single available check contradicts the warrant with no pointer to what resolves it. The claim is true — the parent's verdict is ACCEPT 0/0 at 3f2146ec — but I had that digest only because I reviewed two sibling extractions from this parent earlier today, which is not a route the corpus can rely on, and I say so in the finding. The timing removes the excuse: the parent verdict was written at 03:11 and this file at 03:13. And it matters more here than anywhere else in the lineage, because this is the file D-086's promise routes a reader to, while the v3 extraction that does carry a parentReview object sits at a path nobody is promised. The repair is that object, already written two paths over. Two advisories: authorityClaim omits four express refusals the v3 sibling carries, though none of those things is actually done here and the standing fields cover it; and the extraction pins no HEAD, file 08 digest or required-now and carries no reviewStatus or sealRecommendation, which all three versions lack, so it is a family shape and one disposition would cover it.
